name: Engineers Australia student membership
summary: Free membership for engineering students, with a jobs board, events and internship resources.
who: Anyone studying an accredited or recognised Australian engineering course, from advanced diplomas to conversion master's degrees.
numbers: Videos and tips on landing internships
how: Create a free account in the Engineers Australia member portal and enter your course details.
catches: Many technical societies are also free for students, including Transport Australia, Railway Technical, Australian Tunnelling and Sustainable Engineering. Others charge a small fee.
